QUOTE: `ssl_pthread_server.c` builds to a stub `main` that prints "MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD not defined" and exits when threading is off (lines 24–29).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads and that the pthread example compiles to a stub main. But it also lists thread-spawn sites in `programs/` (benchmark, ssl_server2) and never concludes that a default build creates no threads at all.
